text:
CATEGORY::analytics
Description
This iRules command enables or disables the analytics server on a per
request basis.
Note: This command requires the SWG license.
Syntax
CATEGORY
::
analytics
disable
CATEGORY
::
analytics
enable
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
set
this_uri
http:
//
[
HTTP
::
host
][
HTTP
::
uri
]
set
reply
[
CATEGORY
::
lookup
$this_uri
]
log
local0.
"uri $this_uri returns category=$reply"
if
{
$reply
equals
"Adult Material"
}
{
CATEGORY
::
analytics
enable
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_REQUEST
,
HTTP_RESPONSE
